rationale: Approve the exact zero-delta proposal for IPDF-GOV-02, IPDF-ANA-06, IPDF-VOC-01 and IPDF-VOC-02. The unchanged frozen benchmark has completed independent source, access, task/facet and omission review; I independently assessed the new clause demands before proposal exposure and then every author case against exact final values, including newly relevant parents/tasks and targeted source rereads. No additional warranted access obligation or misleading equivalence was found. All exact bindings and before/after IDs and weights were independently verified. Targeted inspection counts are not whole-population proof; the detailed clause review states the preserved full-review basis and fresh inspection limits. No source, priority, evidence, scope or weighting changes occur. Approval does not freeze the amendment, select a lock, activate a runtime or evaluate any candidate.
